environment: Civilization V BNW / installed Community Patch v151 database schema

static_validation.sql_activation: Installed BNW/CP schema and read-only copy of active Civ5DebugDatabase.db, all modifications in memory
static_validation.inheritance: All active Pikeman/Workshop scalar and direct companion rows; changed baseline, extra scalar columns and additive Culture tested
static_validation.lua_syntax: All packaged and fixture Lua parsed under Lua 5.1
static_validation.yield_arithmetic: CP-derived integer arithmetic models for additive/category/Golden Age modifiers, post-modifier/trade yields, suppression, zero yields, overflow and rounding; not compiled DLL execution
static_validation.save_api_evidence: Installed Firaxis dot-call examples and read-only save-database schema; closed native binding execution and serializer round trip unperformed
static_validation.save_call_native_rejection: unconfirmed; the strict shipped-call-form model rejects colon calls, but shipped examples alone do not prove a permissive native binding rejects both forms
static_validation.package_integrity: ZIP CRC and 327 game-file MD5 values checked; genuine 7z Civ5Mod testzip passed

mocked_lua_tests.scope: Pre-PlayerDoTurn illustrative harvests, context reloads plus actual fixture snapshot rewinds, same-turn independent games, pre-staging autosaves at 5/6 and 11/12, absent keys, native-shaped post-sale lifecycle, transient/persistent faults, notification recovery, ownership, deletion, corruption cleanup and dirty events

required_acceptance: Actual stored Production and research deltas entering played turns 6, 7, 12 and 13
Native active-turn and interturn save/load round trips, including pre-PlayerDoneTurn engine autosaves
Guard friendly-territory attack, defense and upgrade retention
Native localization, icons, static leader scene and Dawn of Man rendering

documented_limits: Next-turn dummies are staged during the interturn because PlayerDoTurn follows economic settlement
Native end-turn autosave resumption before PlayerDoneTurn is source-traced and modeled but still needs empirical verification
Persistent engine/database/setter failures beyond the bounded synchronous retry can still affect a harvest and are logged explicitly
First-time activation after a Chime harvest cannot retroactively credit that harvest
Notifications only; no continuous countdown UI
Standard Pikeman battlefield model and static illustrated diplomacy scene
